<thought>Analyzing the spectrum shows a strong M+1 peak (~20% of base) indicating many 13C atoms, confirming carbon presence. A smaller M+2 peak (~2% of base) aligns with the natural abundance of 34S, confirming sulfur. No other element shows a characteristic isotopic pattern strong enough for definitive identification.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'S']</final_answer>
